    Amit Kumar PandeyAmit Kumar Pandey • 1stPremium • 1st Assistant Professor | Academic Innovator | Department of AIML | Thakur College of Science and commerce | Faculty Incharge TCSC - ONGC, NPTEL, IIT BOMBAY | IPR ExpertAssistant Professor | Academic Innovator | Department of AIML | Thakur College of Science and commerce | Faculty Incharge TCSC - ONGC, NPTEL, IIT BOMBAY | IPR Expert 17h • 17 hours ago • Visible to anyone on or off LinkedIn
    Excited to announce that I have successfully completed the LinkedIn Learning certification on “Transforming Business with AI Agents: Autonomous Efficiency and Decision-Making” under the insightful guidance of Charlene Li.

    This course provided a strategic perspective on how AI agents are transforming modern enterprises by enabling intelligent automation, accelerating decision-making, and improving operational efficiency at scale. It also emphasized the growing importance of aligning technology with business vision, leadership adaptability, and customer-centric innovation in today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape.

    One of the key takeaways for me was understanding that AI is no longer just a technological advantage — it is becoming a business necessity for organizations aiming to remain competitive, agile, and future-ready. The concepts explored in this program strongly align with my passion for continuous learning, digital transformation, and leveraging emerging technologies to create meaningful business impact.

    I sincerely appreciate LinkedIn Learning and Charlene Li for delivering such a valuable and forward-thinking learning experience. Looking forward to applying these insights in real-world scenarios and continuing my journey in the evolving world of AI and business innovation.

    hashtag#LinkedInLearning hashtag#ArtificialIntelligence hashtag#AIAgents hashtag#DigitalTransformation hashtag#AIForBusiness hashtag#BusinessInnovation hashtag#Leadership hashtag#FutureOfWork hashtag#ContinuousLearning hashtag#Innovation hashtag#ProfessionalGrowth

    Amit Kumar PandeyAmit Kumar Pandey • 1stPremium • 1st Assistant Professor | Academic Innovator | Department of AIML | Thakur College of Science and commerce | Faculty Incharge TCSC - ONGC, NPTEL, IIT BOMBAY | IPR ExpertAssistant Professor | Academic Innovator | Department of AIML | Thakur College of Science and commerce | Faculty Incharge TCSC - ONGC, NPTEL, IIT BOMBAY | IPR Expert 1d • 1 day ago • Visible to anyone on or off LinkedIn
    Honored to be invited as an AI Expert at the 12th AI Meetup organized by the Mumbai AI Forum at Indian Institute of Technology Bombay on the theme “AI in Real Estate.”

    The event brought together innovators, entrepreneurs, researchers, and AI enthusiasts to explore how Artificial Intelligence is transforming the future of Real Estate and Construction.

    Key highlights from this insightful meetup:

    🔹 Opening remarks and welcome address by Prof. Sandesh (IDC, IIT Bombay)
    🔹 Inspiring session by Shaji Varghese, CEO – SINE IIT Bombay, discussing the Titanium Program and innovation initiatives at SINE Technology
    🔹 Meaningful conversations around the challenges of AI adoption in the Real Estate industry
    🔹 Excellent session by Srinivas K Pai, Co-Founder – Pace Robotics, on Robots in Constructionand the future of automation-driven infrastructure
    🔹 Impressive presentation on Claude Agents, AI tools, and PropMind 360° for Real Estate innovation
    🔹 Insightful closing session by Mr. Varun Saxena, Director – AI & Analytics, Anarock Property Consultants Pvt. Ltd., on CRM, Predictive AI, and Generative AI applications in Real Estate.

    It was also wonderful interacting with talented students like Ratnesh Pathak and Kishan Mishra, along with engaging discussions with fellow speakers after the sessions.

    The discussions strongly reflected that the convergence of AI, Robotics, Analytics, and Generative AI is no longer futuristic — it is actively reshaping the Real Estate ecosystem today.

    Grateful to the organizers, speakers, students, and attendees for such an inspiring and future-focused platform.

    hashtag#AI hashtag#ArtificialIntelligence hashtag#AIInRealEstate hashtag#MumbaiAIForum hashtag#IITBombay hashtag#GenerativeAI hashtag#PredictiveAI hashtag#Robotics hashtag#ConstructionTech hashtag#RealEstate hashtag#Innovation hashtag#Technology hashtag#Networking hashtag#MachineLearning

    This research work explores the application of data analysis and predictive modeling techniques for understanding and forecasting Sea Surface Temperature (SST), which plays a significant role in climate studies, oceanographic research, and environmental monitoring.

    🚀 Excited to announce the publication of my research article:
    "Advancing Marine Biodiversity Monitoring: A Hybrid Deep Learning and Machine Learning Framework Leveraging ResNet Feature Extraction with Random Forest and KNN Classifiers" in International Journal of Progressive Research in Engineering Management and Science (IJPREMS), Volume 05, Issue 03, March 2025.

    This paper delves into innovative methodologies for enhancing marine biodiversity monitoring using cutting-edge hybrid approaches that combine Deep Learning and Machine Learning techniques. By leveraging ResNet for feature extraction alongside Random Forest and KNN classifiers, we aim to significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of biodiversity assessments, which is critical for sustainable environmental management. 🌍

    I’m incredibly grateful for the opportunity to contribute to the advancement of this field and to collaborate with like-minded professionals striving for impactful change.
